interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the nearest intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming such as speed humps to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint at intersections to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety at night.

interventions.title: Plant Street Trees
interventions.description: Introduce street trees in the buffer zone to provide physical separation, shade, and a traffic calming effect.
